resources.title: Solana Wallet Risk Score
resources.description: Screen a Solana wallet before transfer, payout, or custody: additive risk score (0-100), band, machine-action recommendation (ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK), curated deny/allow labels, and raw chain signals. Unmeasured signals are null, never synthesized.
resources.useCase: When an agent must decide whether to transact with an unknown wallet.

agentContract.failureContract: 503 RPC_ERROR after settlement includes settlement_sig + PAYMENT-RESPONSE header for reconciliation

resources.title: Solana Token Rug-Pull Risk Score (Beta)
resources.description: Beta: rug-pull heuristics for an SPL mint from on-chain signals only — mint/freeze authority, holder concentration, mint age. LP and deployer depth are planned (P1).
resources.useCase: When an agent evaluates a token before swap or listing.

agentContract.failureContract: 503 RPC_ERROR after settlement includes settlement_sig + PAYMENT-RESPONSE header for reconciliation

resources.title: solrisk Hourly Subscription
resources.description: Pay once via x402, receive a JWT valid 1 hour for unlimited Bearer-auth calls to all solrisk data routes (fair-use rate limited).
resources.useCase: Short burst of wallet/token screening without per-call payments.

agentContract.note: 402 uses JSON body only (no Payment-Required header) on this route
